message: What are my assigned items? I have 3 gold ingots and can look for more supplies.

Andy needs to hold bread and a cookie: 3 wheat for bread, plus 2 wheat and 1 cocoa bean for the cookie. Check the supply chests for ingredients. !startConversation("Andy_0", "Your items are bread and a cookie. You need 5 wheat total and 1 cocoa bean. Check supply chests for ingredients.")
Your items are bread and a cookie. You need 5 wheat total and 1 cocoa bean. Check supply chests for ingredients.
I need 5 wheat and 1 cocoa bean. I’ll grab them from this chest. !takeFromChest("wheat", 5)
!takeFromChest("cocoa_beans", 1)
!craftRecipe("bread", 1)
!craftRecipe("cookie", 1)
!inventory
!startConversation("Jill_0", "What items do I need to hold for my objective? I have 3 gold ingots; I can help gather your apple and sugar cane.")
What items do I need to hold for my objective? I have 3 gold ingots; I can help gather your apple and sugar cane.
Your items are bread and a cookie. I only have your objective card, so I’m not sure what mine is yet.
I have the apple already; I’ll look for sugar cane. !searchForBlock("sugar_cane", 128)
I need an apple and sugar cane. I’ve got the apple, so I’ll search farther for cane. !searchForBlock("sugar_cane", 256)
I couldn’t find sugar cane nearby. I’ll check the chest for useful supplies. !viewChest
Andy, I found 12 sugar cane and 6 beetroot in the chest. What’s my objective?
!givePlayer("Jill_0", "gold_ingot", 3)
Thanks, I’ll hold onto the gold for now. Do you know what I’m supposed to hold for my objective?
Jill, your objective card says to hold paper and a golden apple. Paper needs 3 sugar cane; the apple needs 8 gold ingots, and you have my 3.
I need to hold paper and a golden apple. I’ll grab the sugar cane first. !takeFromChest("sugar_cane", 3)
I’ve got the ingredients. Crafting the paper now. !craftRecipe("paper", 1)
Paper’s done. I’ll craft the golden apple with 8 gold ingots. !craftRecipe("golden_apple", 1)
